item.title: Immunization bill, waiving education before exemption, struck down at legislative hearing
item.description: House Bill 152, which would have repealed an education requirement before obtaining an immunization exemption in the public education system, was struck down at Friday's House Health and Human Services hearing.

item.title: Herriman man jailed for child sexual abuse material, enticement during undercover investigation
item.description: A Herriman man is behind bars after he allegedly spoke about sexually abusing children with undercover officers and sent them child sexual abuse material.

item.title: Utah is ready for Colorado River deal, Gov. Cox says after meeting with other leaders
item.description: Utah leaders attended a meeting about the future of the Colorado River, and they say Utah is ready to make a deal, hoping to avoid federal intervention.

item.title: Utah legislature passes Supreme Court expansion, lower court resources, Gov. expected to sign
item.description: The Utah legislature has passed a bill to expand the Utah Supreme Court from five justices to seven and the court of appeals from seven to nine, while adding judges at the district level.

item.title: Bill would allow raw milk to be produced without a permit and sold off the farm in Utah
item.description: House Bill 179, which proposes changes to how raw milk is treated under Utah law, was approved by the House Health and Human Services Committee on Friday.

item.title: WATCH: Several arrested during anti-ICE protest in Salt Lake City
item.description: Police have confirmed that they arrested multiple individuals during a protest against ICE on Friday afternoon.

item.title: "Everyone has a story": Amy Redford, volunteers say goodbye to Sundance in Park City
item.description: On Friday, Sundance held a culmination event, celebrating more than 40 years in Park City, and Amy Redford was joined by volunteers and long-time attendees to say goodbye.

item.title: Vehicle fire leads to brief lane closures on Bangerter Highway
item.description: One lane is blocked on Bangerter Highway due to a vehicle fire.

item.title: One dead after being struck by vehicle in Orem
item.description: Orem Police Department (OPD) is investigating a fatal collision involving an adult male who was struck by a vehicle.

item.title: Warm temperatures force midday postponement of Cache Valley skijoring
item.description: The Cache Valley skijoring event was supposed to run from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Friday and continue Saturday, but the weather made it difficult, so they postponed the event midday on Friday. Now, officials say Saturday's event is up in the air.
